# MathLive 0.110.0

Vendored from the official npm `mathlive` package under the MIT license (see LICENSE.txt).
Only the browser module and its fonts are used. No CDN fallback or telemetry was added.

- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/mathlive/-/mathlive-0.110.0.tgz
- Documentation: https://mathlive.io/mathfield/guides/virtual-keyboard/
- SHA-512 of the original archive (base64): `UOpJsQ6h1eeN0xZULGTl1MwUB/lZLCDuzKeHvKEh7Zra8U/rtgDNrssj5PZdJtBTIV48AfEhtv6rv47AeMOxJA==`

MathLive edits notation. Learning Hub's bounded numeric parser grades numeric answers.
Neither this package nor the keyboard is an AI grading service. Firebase and AI Worker configuration are unchanged.
